public_payload.normalized_proposition: Elon Musk's deadlines for technology projects are almost never met.

statement.excerpt: Musk is almost never right about deadlines.
statement.document_title: Top 5 reasons Tesla’s Optimus announcement may turn out be a dud

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that meeting publicly announced technology-project deadlines is exceptional across Musk's projects, not merely that some prominent projects were late.
Consider deadlines that had fallen due by September 29, 2022. The statement supplies no starting year.
Repeated revisions of one project's deadline must be distinguished from separate projects. A collection selected only for failures cannot establish the claimed frequency.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently representative record of Musk's public technology-project deadlines and corresponding delivery dates shows that on-time delivery was exceptional.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently representative record shows that meeting deadlines was reasonably common. An isolated success is insufficient because 'almost never' allows exceptions.
